LESSON: ARTICULATION OF LETTER SOUNDS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.2: Articulation of letter sounds
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Articulation of letter sounds, part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do different sounds in school help us?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify vowel sounds from a list of letters of the alphabet,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Articulation of letter sounds in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. articulate correctly vowels as letter sounds from the alphabet,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Articulation of letter sounds in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. take pleasure in articulating vowels and other letter sounds. • Observe charts with all the letters of the alphabet on the wall. ● Recite letters of the alphabet. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Articulation of letter sounds together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Teamwork as the learner collaboratively works in pairs and in groups to articulate letter

sounds in preparation for reading.

● Communication and collaboration: Listening and speaking as the learner listens to articulation of the vowels from the teacher

or a digital device and imitate.

Values:
● Peace is developed as the learner together with others work in harmony to articulate letter sounds and vowels.

● Unity is enhanced as the learner interacts with others to achieve a common goal (articulation of sounds).

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health education awareness is enhanced as the learner learns that loud sounds within the school environment and outside the

school can affect our hearing.

Link to other Learning Areas: Creative activities as the learner engages in sound articulation games.

Suggested learning resources: Boards ,charts, digital device ,bag, pens used in sound articulation
